1207|1342|1346|Introduction of PB QR Payment Options We are excited to announce the launch of PB QR Payment options, a new feature that enables faster, contactless, and more secure transactions through QR code technology. This initiative supports our move toward a more seamless and cashless banking experience for customers and merchants alike. What is PB QR Payment? PB QR Payment allows users to make payments by scanning a QR code generated by merchants, service providers, or billers. It eliminates the need for physical cards or keying in account numbers, offering a convenient and secure alternative to traditional payment methods. Key Features Instant Payments:Real-time transfer of funds using DuitNow QR, the national QR standard. Wide Compatibility:Customers can use the PB QR Payment option through the MyPB App, which supports DuitNow QR-compatible merchants. No Physical Contact Required:Fully contactless for enhanced hygiene and safety, especially in face-to-face transactions. Digital Receipts:Instant transaction confirmation and receipt generation within the app. Where Can It Be Used? Retail stores and outlets accepting DuitNow QR Online merchants with QR payment support Utility and service bills with integrated QR codes Branch counters (for specific banking services) How to Use PB QR Payment Open the MyPB App Tap on the QR Pay icon Scan the merchant or biller’s QR code Enter the amount (if required) Confirm and authorize the payment Security and Controls Transactions are protected by biometric login or PIN authentication. Daily transaction limits can be set and managed by users. Alerts and transaction history are available in-app for full transparency. Effective Date Available from: 1 August 2025Ensure your app is updated to the latest version to access the QR payment feature. Need Assistance? 1207|1342|1347|Policy on Sustainable Financing Framework As part of our commitment to responsible banking and environmental stewardship, we have established a Policy on Sustainable Financing Framework. This framework sets out the principles, criteria, and governance processes for integrating environmental, social, and governance (ESG) considerations into our financing activities. Objective The Sustainable Financing Framework aims to: Support projects and clients that contribute positively to environmental and social outcomes. Align our lending and investment decisions with global sustainability goals, including the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UN SDGs) and the Paris Agreement. Manage ESG risks and promote long-term financial and societal value. Key Principles ESG Integration:Environmental and social risk assessments are embedded into the credit evaluation and decision-making process. Eligibility Criteria:Financing will prioritize sectors and projects that meet one or more of the following: Renewable energy Energy efficiency Clean transportation Green buildings Sustainable agriculture Affordable housing Social impact enterprises Exclusion List:Financing will not be provided to activities with significant environmental or social harm, including: Illegal logging or deforestation Coal-fired power plants (new projects) Hazardous waste trade Child labor or exploitative practices Implementation and Oversight A dedicated Sustainable Financing Committee oversees the application and monitoring of this policy. All relevant departments (Credit, Risk, Compliance) are trained and accountable for applying ESG filters during their workflows. Approved sustainable financing transactions may be tagged and reported under green, social, or sustainability-linked categories. Monitoring and Reporting Annual reporting on sustainable financing volumes, impact metrics, and compliance is submitted to management and stakeholders. Metrics include carbon emission reductions, renewable energy capacity supported, and number of beneficiaries impacted. Effective Date Effective from: 1 August 2025Applies to all new financing proposals and renewals exceeding a defined threshold. Our Commitment This policy reflects our broader mission to promote responsible growth, inclusive economic development, and environmental resilience. We remain committed to evolving this framework in line with industry best practices and regulatory expectations. 📌 Further Information Full policy document available in the Document Management System (DMS) under:Policies → Sustainability → Sustainable Financing Framework For questions or support, please contact the Sustainability Risk Unit at: sustainability@yourbank.com | It ensures that all customer data is handled with the utmost integrity, in compliance with legal and regulatory requirements. This framework serves as a critical component in maintaining trust between the bank and its clients by protecting sensitive financial and personal information from unauthorized disclosure or misuse. It also provides clear guidance to staff on permissible circumstances for information sharing, as well as the responsibilities associated with safeguarding customer privacy. Adherence to the Banking Secrecy Framework is mandatory for all employees and stakeholders, forming a foundation for ethical conduct and secure banking operations. | 1207|1358|1360|Content 1: Purpose and Importance of Banking Secrecy Banking secrecy is fundamental to preserving the confidentiality and integrity of customer relationships. The primary purpose of this framework is to ensure that all customer information—whether related to identity, accounts, transactions, or financial history—is protected against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure. This confidentiality obligation extends to all employees, third-party service providers, and any individual granted access to internal systems. By enforcing banking secrecy: Customer trust is reinforced, fostering long-term relationships. Legal and regulatory compliance is achieved, in line with national banking laws and industry standards. Reputational risk is minimized, protecting the bank from breaches that could damage its credibility. Operational integrity is maintained, supporting secure and responsible data handling practices. All employees are expected to understand and apply these principles in their day-to-day responsibilities, with strict consequences for non-compliance. | 1207|1358|1362|Banking Secrecy Framework Table of Contents 1. Introduction 2. Purpose and Importance of Banking Secrecy 3. Scope and Application 1. Introduction The Banking Secrecy Framework outlines the principles, policies, and procedures that govern the confidentiality of customer information within the bank. It ensures that all customer data is handled with the utmost integrity, in compliance with legal and regulatory requirements. This framework serves as a critical component in maintaining trust between the bank and its clients by protecting sensitive financial and personal information from unauthorized disclosure or misuse. It also provides clear guidance to staff on permissible circumstances for information sharing, as well as the responsibilities associated with safeguarding customer privacy. Adherence to the Banking Secrecy Framework is mandatory for all employees and stakeholders, forming a foundation for ethical conduct and secure banking operations. 2. Purpose and Importance of Banking Secrecy Banking secrecy is fundamental to preserving the confidentiality and integrity of customer relationships. The primary purpose of this framework is to ensure that all customer information—whether related to identity, accounts, transactions, or financial history—is protected against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure. Customer trust is reinforced, fostering long-term relationships. Legal and regulatory compliance is achieved, in line with national banking laws and industry standards. Reputational risk is minimized, protecting the bank from breaches that could damage its credibility. Operational integrity is maintained, supporting secure and responsible data handling practices. All employees are expected to understand and apply these principles in their day-to-day responsibilities, with strict consequences for non-compliance. 3. Scope and Application The Banking Secrecy Framework applies to all customer-related information obtained or handled in the course of business activities, regardless of the format—physical, digital, or verbal. This includes, but is not limited to: Personal identification details (e.g., name, address, contact number, identification numbers) Account information (e.g., balances, transactions, account types) Financial records, loan details, and credit history Correspondence between the bank and the customer Any internal reports, analysis, or observations involving customer data The framework applies to: All employees (permanent, contract, and temporary) Subsidiaries and affiliates of the bank External vendors, consultants, or service providers with system or data access Any parties handling customer data on behalf of the bank The framework remains applicable even after termination of employment or service. All parties must continue to respect and protect customer confidentiality in accordance with legal and ethical standards. |
